title: User Create Request
description: Create a new RMS user account. 'username' (a valid e-mail address) is required. 'password' is optional - when omitted the server generates a random password that is never disclosed, so the user has to reset it before first login. All other fields are optional.

username.description: Login e-mail of the new user. Must not already exist.

password.description: Optional plain-text password, minimum 6 characters. Omit it to have the server generate a random password that nobody knows; the user then has to reset the password before the first login.

canLogin.description: Whether the user is allowed to log in. Defaults to true.

lang.description: Preferred locale in ll_CC format, e.g. "en_US".

givenName.description: Given (first) name stored as user meta.

familyName.description: Family (last) name stored as user meta.

grant.description: Rights to grant to the new user, e.g. ["member of administrators"].
